utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?
Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.
Oh my, it sounds like you're really overwhelmed. Can I help with anything?
Thanks, Grandma! I think I can manage, but I appreciate the offer.
Oh, I see! Thank you for explaining that to me. I'm glad you're okay.
Is there anything else you'd like to share about your day?
Well, I did have a bit of a rough start this morning, but things got better later on.
Oh, I see. How are things going with him?
Things are going pretty well with him. We had a nice chat yesterday.
Oh, that's good to hear. Are you planning anything fun together?
Yeah, we're thinking of going to the new art exhibit this weekend. It should be fun!
Yes, you did it! I'm proud of you.
